run_starlette_diffusers_app: run the starlette app that serves text-to-image and image-to-image diffusers pipelines via HTTP
get_pipeline_by_task: get a cached diffusers pipeline instance for a given TASK and MODEL_ID environment variable
configure_allowed_tasks: configure the ALLOWED_TASKS dictionary to map task names to their corresponding pipeline classes
setup_startup_event: setup the async startup event that initializes logging, idle check loop, and pipeline loading
reset_logging_debug: reset logging to debug level with timestamp and message format using force mode
